title: Sequential GRACE codebook growth with shared Mirror value basis
hypothesis: A shared rank-4 value basis compresses a growing discrete edit codebook while preserving retention and scope locality; Mirror must beat native PCA value coding after lookup/decode cost.
routing: Nearest-key lookup with fixed deferral radius identical across methods; charge key vectors, radii, edit order and IDs in every payload.
storage: Actual serialized inference .npz bytes at every growth snapshot, including base executor, all memory state, basis/codes or values and metadata.
success_gate: At every snapshot and both seeds: retention nRMSE <=1e-5, positive hit >=99%, false positives <=1%, and complete bytes <=75% explicit GRACE. Mirror-specific gain also requires strict improvement over native PCA coding.
failure_gate: Retention/scope/storage miss or exact native PCA alias. Fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: No pretrained model or real continual editing
Calibration basis is paid as model state
